purpose: Faction camp models for the 3D campaign map (진영 전역): joseon, japan and ming navies at camp tiers 1-3.

images.style: A single isolated 3D game-asset render made for image-to-3D conversion. One compact sixteenth-century naval camp modelled as a single object standing on its own thin, flat ground base of packed earth and short grass, only a few centimetres thick, with softly bevelled edges, the base about as deep as it is wide. Camera: high three-quarter view about 40 degrees above the horizon, looking at one corner of the base so two sides are visible; the whole model is centred and completely inside the frame with a generous empty margin all round. Lighting: soft, even, shadowless studio light from all sides, no cast shadows, no dark ambient-occlusion halos. Look: clean stylised realism like a premium historical strategy-game building, chunky simplified architecture with large clearly readable roofs and strong clean colours that still read when the model is tiny on screen; no fine clutter, no small props. The waterfront is on ONE side only: the left-front edge of the base, where the jetty or quay projects out toward the lower left of the picture, its deck level with the base. Transparent background. Nothing beyond the base: no water, no sea, no terrain or trees outside the base, no ships or boats, no people, no animals. Absolutely no text, letters, characters, numbers, logos, emblems or crests anywhere, no rising-sun flag, no sunburst, no watermark, no border.

factions.joseon: Joseon Korean navy, 1592: grey ceramic-tiled roofs with gracefully upturned eaves and white mortar ridges, white lime-plaster walls framed by dark brown timber, grey granite and rammed-earth walls, plain blue and plain white cloth banners with no emblem.
factions.japan: Sengoku Japanese navy, 1592, in the style of a wajo coastal fortress: white plaster walls standing on steeply sloped fitted grey stone bases, black and dark grey tiled roofs with curved gables, dark timber, plain white and plain red cloth nobori banners with no emblem or symbol of any kind.
factions.ming: Ming Chinese navy, 1598: grey brick walls with crenellated battlements, red-lacquered timber gate towers with yellow-glazed tiled roofs, grey stone, grey-tiled barracks, plain red and plain yellow cloth banners with no emblem.

tiers.joseon-1: TIER 1, a modest new camp: a ring of sharpened upright log palisade with one simple timber gate around a small earthen yard, two small thatched huts and one small grey-tiled hut, a tall pole with a plain blue banner, and a short timber jetty on the waterfront side.
tiers.joseon-2: TIER 2, a walled naval station: a continuous wall of grey granite blocks topped with a white plastered parapet, a gate with a small grey-tiled gate pavilion, a wooden watchtower, two long grey-tiled barracks and a storehouse inside, plain blue and white banners, and a broad timber pier on the waterfront side.
tiers.joseon-3: TIER 3, a fortress port: high grey granite fortress walls with crenellated white parapets and four corner towers with small tiled pavilions, a fortified gate, in the centre a large Joseon command hall on a raised stone platform with many dark red pillars and a huge grey hip-and-gable tiled roof with upturned eaves, tiled barracks, bronze cannon emplacements on the ramparts, and a long straight stone quay along the waterfront side with a roofed boathouse dock, empty, no ship.
tiers.japan-1: TIER 1, a modest new camp: a ring of sharpened upright log palisade partly hung with plain white cloth curtain screens, one simple gate, three white canvas tents and a small dark-roofed timber hut around a small yard, tall plain white and plain red nobori banners, and a short timber jetty on the waterfront side.
tiers.japan-2: TIER 2, a walled naval station: a wall of white plaster on a sloped fitted stone base with dark tiled coping, a gate with a white plaster turret over it, a two-storey white corner turret (yagura) with black tiled roofs, two dark-tiled barracks and a storehouse inside, plain white and red banners, and a timber pier on the waterfront side.
tiers.japan-3: TIER 3, a fortress port (wajo): tiers of steeply sloped stone walls topped with white plaster walls, white two-storey corner turrets, a fortified gate, in the centre a tall four-storey white tenshu keep with black tiled roofs and curved gables, dark-tiled barracks, cannon emplacements on the walls, plain white and red banners, and a long straight stone quay along the waterfront side with a roofed dock, empty, no ship.
tiers.ming-1: TIER 1, a modest new camp: a square palisade of sharpened upright logs with one simple gate around a small earthen yard, a tall square wooden watchtower, three canvas tents and a small grey-tiled hut, plain red and plain yellow banners, and a short timber jetty on the waterfront side.
tiers.ming-2: TIER 2, a walled naval station: a square grey brick wall with crenellated battlements, a gate with a red-lacquered gate tower under a yellow-glazed tiled roof, a brick watchtower at one corner, two grey-tiled barracks and a storehouse inside, plain red and yellow banners, and a timber pier on the waterfront side.
tiers.ming-3: TIER 3, a fortress port: a square fortress of high grey brick walls with crenellated battlements and four square corner towers, over the main gate a great two-storey red-lacquered gate tower with double yellow-glazed tiled roofs, grey-tiled barracks and a yellow-roofed hall inside, cannon emplacements on the walls, plain red and yellow banners, and a long straight stone quay along the waterfront side with a roofed dock, empty, no ship.

images.grow: The reference image is the previous tier of this very camp. Keep exactly its rendering style, lighting, camera angle, base size and shape, colour palette and transparent background, and keep the waterfront on the same left-front side; rebuild the camp on that base as follows.

texturePrompts.ming: Ming Chinese naval fort, stylised realistic hand-painted look: grey brick walls and battlements, red-lacquered timber, yellow-glazed roof tiles on the gate towers, grey roof tiles on the barracks, grey stone, packed light-brown earth ground with short green grass at the edges, weathered grey-brown timber decks, plain red and plain yellow cloth banners.
